name: Police- Community Relations Awards 2016
description: This dataset lists four community organizations that received Police-Community Relations Awards in fiscal year 2016, each awarded $12,000. For every recipient it records the organization name, project title, project address, postcode, borough, and geographic identifiers including latitude and longitude, community board, council district, census tract, building identification number (BIN), borough-block-lot (BBL), and neighborhood tabulation area (NTA). The records cover locations in Manhattan and Brooklyn. The data can be used to map and profile award-funded police-community relations projects, compare their distribution across neighborhoods and council districts, or join with other New York City geographic datasets for further analysis.
